text: In cohesive HoTT, ♭A (flat/discrete) satisfies: for any discrete type B,
choices: Hom(A, B) ≃ Hom(♭A, B) — maps out of A into discrete types factor through ♭A
Hom(♭A, B) ≃ Hom(A, ♯B) — maps out of ♭A correspond to maps into codiscrete B
explanation: ♭ is the coreflection onto the discrete types: Hom(A, B)_{disc} ≅ Hom(♭A, B) for discrete B. This is the universal property of the flat modality.
